description.value: Longwood Brewery's Boxwood Road tasting room is a production brewery and growler bar named one of "the most local of local breweries and beers in BC" by The Tyee Magazine, sourcing the majority of its hops and barley from Vancouver Island and BC mainland farms. Opened in 2012 as the brand's second location, it pours six core beers and four rotating seasonals ranging from a Continental Pilsner to an Imperial Stout. A seasonal uncovered picnic patio is pet- and family-friendly, with no onsite kitchen.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active seasonal tasting room and growler bar at Longwood Brewery's production facility on Boxwood Road, Nanaimo, open from late March through December. Phone (250-591-2739) and address (101A-2046 Boxwood Road, Nanaimo, BC V9S 5W7) match between OSM and website. No bike parking, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null; growler sales confirm takeout, and an explicit 'no onsite kitchen for food service' statement confirms packed lunches are unavailable.
concerns: OSM opening_hours (We-Fr 14:00-18:00; Sa 11:00-17:00) omits Tuesday and shows Saturday opening at 11:00, but website shows Tuesday–Friday 2pm–6pm and Saturday 12pm–5pm — OSM hours appear outdated.

OSM name is 'Longwood Tasting Room' but the business is also marketed as 'Longwood Brewery on Boxwood Road'; the identity is clear but may cause confusion with the separate Brew Pub & Restaurant location.
No bike parking of any kind is mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, which is a gap for the required 'Bike parking or visibility' criterion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate and active craft brewery tasting room with strong local identity, but no bike parking or cyclist-specific amenities are confirmed; recommend including only if bike parking can be verified on-site or via street-level imagery.

Packed lunches.detail: Website states "no onsite kitchen for food service" and "we encourage you to bring food as we do not have a kitchen for food service."
